items.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials

items.title: Stalwart: Open-source Microsoft Exchange replacement
items.snippet: Stalwart, an open source mail server, shipped version 1.2.0 with support for the protocols Exchange clients speak: MAPI over HTTP, Exchange Web Services (EWS), Exchange ActiveSync and Autodiscover. Outlook, Apple Mail and the built-in apps on phones connect to it as they would to an Exchange server, with mail, calendar
items.summary: Stalwart, an open-source mail server, released version 1.2.0 with support for protocols used by Exchange clients.
items.why: Assess protocol compatibility and security requirements before adopting a mail-server alternative.

analysis.headline: Security, access, and reach across connected systems
paragraphs: The top stories span cybersecurity, space, and autonomous navigation. CISA's catalog update and Austria's reported website breach put vulnerability management and exposed contact information in focus. Separately, Belgian funding for autonomous navigation targets spacecraft operating when satellite signals and other external references are unavailable.

The stories suggest that organizations and analysts must consider both access to systems and reliance on external infrastructure. CrowdStrike's proposed purchase of Zscaler is framed by its CEO as a path toward a large AI safety and security company; the report offers a corporate ambition, not evidence of what the purchase would deliver.

The space report rests on what German media said about a planned Russian satellite, while NATO's chief vows defence against a space threat. That claim and the navigation initiative make space systems a shared point of attention. Watch for further reporting on the catalog additions, breach scope, and how the navigation technologies are intended to work.
takeaways: Use CISA's catalog to guide vulnerability review and remediation.
Treat employee contact information as sensitive after a website breach.
Track how space-threat reporting relates to autonomous navigation.
